title: Extract Data, date, open, high, low, close from tradingview chart.
text:
Data Scraping Extract Data, date, open, high, low, close from tradingview chart.
I need a script or program to extract data from tradingview to [login to view URL] csv file must contain Date, time, open, close, high, low and volume of each bars. In any timeframe I choose in the chart. In any timerange I choose. Example: ELET3/ELET4 in the 5 minute timeframe from 01/01/2014 until today. Get the prices of each bar, date, high,low,open,close in that timerange.
The extraction must be allowed on the data of a pair of symbols. Eg: AAPL/MSFT or BBDC4/BBDC3.
The extraction must be made from Tradingview, no other source works for me.
Please do not bid if you are not capable of doing that I have tryed this project here before and the freelancer was not able to complete the job.
